subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's shared reply sanitizer and normalizer behavior as the fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78177, or require live-channel proof or rework before merge?
rationale: The code and direct production-function proof look sound, but the change alters final reply filtering across channel delivery, and ClawSweeper should not decide maintainer tolerance for over-stripping risk or broad CI triage on its own.

options.title: Merge after CI triage
options.body: Accept the scoped marker matching and current proof, then merge once required checks are green or unrelated failures are explicitly triaged.

options.title: Require live channel proof
options.body: Ask for Mantis or contributor live-channel proof before merge if maintainers want end-to-end evidence beyond direct production-function output.

options.title: Request sanitizer rework
options.body: Ask for narrower matching or centralized marker constants if maintainers want a different permanent contract for scaffold stripping.

recommendation.title: Merge after CI triage
recommendation.body: Accept the scoped marker matching and current proof, then merge once required checks are green or unrelated failures are explicitly triaged.
